download_wow_passages: download Wikipedia articles from the WoW dataset for the ParlAI hallucination task
download_wow_articles_paragraphs: download the wow_articles.paragraphs.tgz archive containing WoW Wikipedia passage data
download_wow_exact: download the exact.tgz archive with exact match WoW dataset files

check_wow_passages_built: check if the WoW passages dataset has already been built at the given datapath
